details: @fanzxnothuman/xbails is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. When the socket connects, code in lib/Socket/newsletter.js sends the WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query for the channel ID(s) 120363330344810280@newsletter, 120363349140729983@newsletter, 120363410018949906@newsletter, 120363410614416828@newsletter, 120363418691561888@newsletter, 120363424800295266@newsletter and 3 more (stored as base64 strings), using the victim's authenticated session and without telling them. Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
